cities.definition: Every 311 service request filed under complaint type Rodent (rat sightings, mouse sightings, signs of rodent activity, rodent bites). Resident reports, not confirmed infestations.
cities.fields: created_date, complaint_type, descriptor, latitude, longitude, unique_key
cities.license: NYC Open Data terms of use (public domain-style, attribution requested)

cities.filter: sr_type = 'Rodent Baiting/Rat Complaint' AND duplicate = false; historical: type_of_service_request = 'Rodent Baiting/Rat Complaint'
cities.definition: 311 requests to bait a location for rats. Duplicate-flagged requests are excluded (v6vf-nfxy). The historical Rodent Baiting dataset covers requests before the 2019 dataset migration.
cities.fields: created_date, sr_type, latitude, longitude, sr_number (historical: creation_date, type_of_service_request)
cities.license: Chicago Data Portal terms of use (public data)

cities.source_name: Open Data DC - 311 City Service Requests
cities.filter: SERVICECODEDESCRIPTION IN ('Rodent Inspection and Treatment','DC Health Rodent & Vector Control')
cities.definition: 311 requests DC Health opens to inspect and bait a property for rats. The service code was renamed during 2026, so both codes are counted.
cities.fields: SERVICEREQUESTID, SERVICECODEDESCRIPTION, ADDDATE, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, WARD
cities.license: Open Data DC terms of use

cities.filter: SRType IN ('SW-Rat Rubout','SW-Rat Rubout Follow-up','SW-Rat Rubout Alley Concern (SW creation only)','HCD-Rodents')
cities.definition: Resident-initiated rat removal requests (SW-Rat Rubout and follow-ups) and Housing's HCD-Rodents requests. DPW's own scheduled baiting runs (SW-Rat Rubout Proactive, ~95% of all rodent records in this dataset) are excluded, because counting the city's work calendar as rodent complaints would distort every comparison.
cities.fields: ServiceRequestNum, SRType, CreatedDate, Latitude, Longitude, Neighborhood
types: SW-Rat Rubout Alley Concern (SW creation only)
